formulas.shareQuantity: All SH boards: direct ceil(600/allocation) under the user's margin-transfer assumption, without exchange buy-lot rounding; SZ: ceil(1000/allocation) rounded up to 100-share lots
formulas.stockLeg: requiredShares × (stock exit open − T-1 close); stock exit is T open, or next exchange-session open when T opens at lower limit
formulas.gross: stock leg + bond leg; no fees, tax or slippage
formulas.peakCapital: normal T sale: max(B, B-S+subscription cash, 0); deferred stock sale: B+subscription cash
formulas.strategyB: close confirms a drawdown of more than 5%; modeled exit price is 95% of the running high, rounded to CNY 0.001
